title: Intervention With Lupin Protein-enriched Foods in Hypercholesterolemic Subjects
brief_summary: The objective of the study is to elucidate the effects of lupin protein (Lupinus angustifolius Boregine) as part of a mixed diet on cardiovascular risk factors and to clarify the role of arginine, one of the most abundant amino acids in lupin protein.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Moderate Hypercholesterolemia (total cholesterol \>= 5.2 mmol/L)
* Age: 20-80 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* Intake of lipid-lowering pharmaceuticals
* Allergy against legumes
* Intolerance or allergy against milk
* Pregnancy, lactation
* Chronic bowel diseases
